verification: Independent read-only fixed-source audit using Invoke-WebRequest; SHA256 of returned UTF-8 content

sources.finding: Public time point has no input/output source marker; callbacks can come from demux/input or audio/video output; system_date can be past/future and INT64_MAX denotes paused.
Internal best_source selects master ES, another ES, then input. Source identity is internal and not present in public callbacks.
Public wrapper converts the time point and suppresses updates while seeking; it does not expose source identity.

decision: After a no-Surface logical seek, recreate clocks for the next background play from the acknowledged position. Do not infer physical output from watch_time alone.
